description: Calculate a full itemized out-the-door price for a vehicle by VIN. ALWAYS ask the customer what state they will register the vehicle in and pass it as buyer_state (two-letter code) — tax depends entirely on where they title, not where the car sits. Georgia buyers get TAVT (7% of fair market value), title, and tag. Out-of-state buyers get a quote that EXCLUDES tax, title, and registration, because Georgia TAVT is not owed when the vehicle is titled elsewhere and J.C. Lewis does not calculate other states' tax here — tell those customers the total excludes their home-state tax and is not the final out-the-door cost. Optionally accepts a trade allowance (which reduces the taxable base under Georgia law), trade payoff, and down payment. The response includes a 'binding' flag — when true every figure is confirmed from live data; when false, treat it as an estimate and say so. Never present a figure this tool did not calculate, and never invent a tax rate for another state.
name: quote_out_the_door
